Camden Council (official returning authority) press release: 'Holborn and St Pancras parliamentary by-election: Results'. JSON-LD datePublished 2026-10-09T04:18:11+02:00; page displays '09 October 2026 | 03:18 Europe/London'. NOTE the JSON-LD carries a +02:00 offset which is not UK time; the on-page display of 03:18 Europe/London is the one to trust.
'A parliamentary by-election was held for Holborn and St Pancras constituency on Thursday 8 October 2026. Following an overnight count, Sagal Abdi-Wali (Labour Party) was elected as MP for Holborn and St Pancras. The turnout was 38.76%.'
OFFICIAL TURNOUT: 38.76% (cf Guardian table 38.63%, Guardian article 38.7%).
